description: Two handlers mutating one cell (§6.1). inc() x2, clearCount(), inc() drives @count 0->1->2->0->1; #display and the snapshot both read 1. The asserted end state differs from the initial state, so the case fails if the handlers or the writes do nothing (S439 review). (Handler is clearCount, not `reset` — `reset` is a reserved identifier per §6.8.2.)
rationale: §6.1 reactive cells: distinct handlers (inc/clearCount) writing the same cell each re-render its interpolation; the writes apply in order — clearCount returns the cell to 0 and the following inc takes it to 1.
